_doc: Datasheet-derived constraints, matched by regex against a component's value or library part name. Pin regexes match KiCad pin names. Fields: io_voltage_max (abs-max on signal pins, V), io_relative (true: limit is the IC's own I/O rail + this margin instead), internal_pullups (pins that may be left floating), internal_load_caps (crystal needs no external load caps), open_drain (pins that need an external pull-up), require (list of {pin, rule: connected|high|low|cap_to_gnd, min_uF, why}). 'source' cites where each number comes from.

parts.source: Bosch BME280 datasheet, abs max VDDIO / pins 4.25 V

require.why: CSB low at power-up latches SPI mode; tie to VDDIO for I2C
SDO sets the I2C address bit; it must not float
100 nF on VDDIO
100 nF on VDD

parts.source: Microchip ATmega328P datasheet: pins VCC+0.5 V abs max; RESET has internal pull-up

require.why: AVCC must be connected to VCC even if the ADC is unused
RESET low holds the MCU in reset

parts.source: ST STM32 datasheets: BOOT0 selects boot memory, NRST has internal pull-up, VDDA must be powered

require.why: BOOT0 high boots the system bootloader instead of flash
VDDA must be powered even if the ADC is unused
internal regulator needs a VCAP capacitor

parts.source: Diodes AP2112 datasheet: 1 uF input and output capacitors

require.why: input capacitor for LDO stability
output capacitor for LDO stability
EN low disables the regulator

parts.source: LM78xx datasheets: 0.33 uF in, 0.1 uF out

require.why: input capacitor, needed when far from the filter cap
output capacitor improves transient response

parts.source: AMS1117 datasheet: 10 uF tantalum on input and output

require.why: input capacitor
output capacitor required for stability

parts.source: LT1129 datasheet: 3.3 uF minimum output capacitor for stability

require.why: output capacitor required for stability
WP floating may enable write protect on some vendors' parts

parts.source: 74HC family: inputs VCC+0.5 V abs max, CMOS inputs must not float
74AHC: inputs tolerate up to 7 V regardless of VCC
MAX232 family: charge-pump capacitors on V+ and V-

require.why: V+ charge-pump reservoir capacitor
V- charge-pump reservoir capacitor

parts.source: CAN transceiver datasheets: Rs/S selects slope or standby mode

require.why: mode-select pin must be tied (to GND for high speed)

parts.source: MaxLinear XR224xx USB hub: digital I/O referenced to VCC33 (3.3 V); VCC5 only feeds the internal regulator
Espressif ESP32 datasheets: I/O not 5 V tolerant

require.why: EN low holds the chip in reset; use RC pull-up
